currentInventory.observation: Current public inventory reconciles the historical estate exactly at station/PDC count.

firstPartyEvidence.finding: Idex provides installation, supervision, billing, maintenance and assistance for customer parking charging estates.
Idex tells each company/site to define authorised users, access rules and a specific tariff; supervision manages access and charging usage.
Idex reference sites include customer-specific employee/visitor charging with Idex handling user billing.

conclusion: Pricing is site/customer-specific; no universal Idex direct tariff and no deterministic anonymous station/EVSE -> site-configured tariff resolver was recovered.
reopenCondition: Exact Idex public/guest station tariff payload, QR/payment endpoint, or first-party/AFIR/QualiCharge numeric tariff tied to exact current EVSE.
